guardrails: Use actual doc/03_brand and doc/04_engineering sources; the README-listed future root skeleton is not an already completed migration.
Keep Modern existing palette/layout and quotation-scoped formal tokens; the delta does not approve recoloring or new Heritage/Luxury palettes/fonts.
Service/product codes and suggested-price/public-approval boundaries are unchanged; knowledge-base names do not create website product classes or new gallery services.
No authorization to create company files/AGENTS/schema, migrate documents, deploy, change DNS or merge the website is inferred from these source instructions.

limitations: Read-only GitHub comparison and fixed-head source inspection; no company or website changes, Git CLI, app build/server, live website/visual checks or new product validation.
